name: Eztli: O Último Sol
summary:
In this game, you control Eztli, the most loyal servant of the Sower of Discord, one of the Aztec gods who rule your people. As ordered, you must fight against three other gods that threaten the Sower's reign. Each one of them commands a natural element. Fight against the forces of water, the power of thunder, and the fury of hurricanes.

Will you be capable of defeating each of these powerful gods?
